> **Security vulnerability?** Do not open a public issue.
> Use [private vulnerability reporting](../../security/advisories/new) instead.

## What is wrong
A clear and concise description: a post that renders wrongly, a broken link, a command or a fact in a post that is not right, a tag page or the feed not working.

## Where
The address of the post or page.

## Expected
What you expected to see. For a mistake in a post, quote the sentence and link a source for the correction.

## Environment (for a rendering problem)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Browser and version | e.g. Firefox 135 |
| Device | desktop / phone / tablet |
| Theme | light / dark |
| Feed reader (if the feed is involved) | e.g. FreshRSS |

## Screenshots
If applicable, add a screenshot.
